# Dynamics Value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DynamicsValue`](gmeow-DynamicsValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DynamicsValue>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A symbolic dynamic level for a [`ToneEvent`](gmeow-ToneEvent.md) — ppp, pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff, fff. A value vocabulary of individuals; measured decibel values are frame-relative Observations outside this vocabulary ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
